C766_invalid__initialization_missing_sep.source_judgment: Valid negative with conforming minimal control.
C766_invalid__initialization_missing_sep.premise: C766 requires :: when this otherwise plain component declaration includes =3. Insert only ::; no other attribute or syntax condition is needed.
C766_invalid__initialization_missing_sep.evidence_limit: GNU gives generic data-declaration syntax recovery and Flang supplies no qualifying causal report. A located target-specific separator report is not reference corroboration.

C767_invalid__initialization_length.source_judgment: Valid negative with conforming minimal control.
C767_invalid__initialization_length.premise: width is a LEN parameter, not a constant primary; its default2 does not make character(width) constant in this initialized definition. Removing the initializer leaves a legal component specification.
C767_invalid__initialization_length.evidence_limit: The blanket parameterized-initializer GNU message also rejects the valid KIND-primary control and is deliberately not credited as this length-constancy cause.

C767_invalid__initialization_lower.source_judgment: Valid negative with conforming minimal control.
C767_invalid__initialization_lower.premise: The lower bound width in value(width:3)=2 is a LEN primary, valid for a component specification but not the stronger initialized-component constant requirement. Delete only =2.
C767_invalid__initialization_lower.evidence_limit: Neither unsupported LEN handling nor blanket parameterized-initializer rejection establishes this lower-bound cause.

C767_invalid__initialization_upper.source_judgment: Valid negative with conforming minimal control.
C767_invalid__initialization_upper.premise: The upper bound width in value(1:width)=2 has the same nonconstant LEN status; the lower bound1 and all other syntax remain valid. Delete only =2.
C767_invalid__initialization_upper.evidence_limit: No qualifying GNU report identifies this actual upper-bound condition. Flang acceptance without that report cannot corroborate the negative.

C767_valid__initialization_kind_primary.premise: integer,kind::extent precedes integer::values(extent)=3 in the same derived-type definition. 7.5.3.1 p5 and10.1.12 p1(12) permit this KIND primary in a constant expression; scalar expansion supplies each element. No instantiation, payload read or arbitrary intrinsic representation selector is required.
C767_valid__initialization_kind_primary.evidence_limit: GNU's blanket rejection is not source invalidity. Flang compile success is f2018 only.

C769_invalid__initialization_pdt_length.source_judgment: Valid negative with conforming minimal control.
C769_invalid__initialization_pdt_length.premise: Both sides have the same scalar element type and saved compatible TARGET premises, but fixed nondeferred width2 versus width3 violates p2/C769. Only the pointer's type parameter changes to3 in the repair.
C769_invalid__initialization_pdt_length.evidence_limit: GNU is silent. The precise Flang width mismatch is f2018 and cannot provide the required f2023 reference qualification.

C769_valid__initialization_extension.premise: parent and child are ordinary nonparameterized types, child extends parent, and the scalar child TARGET is saved and nonallocatable. CLASS(parent) is type compatible with that child; ranks agree and no nondeferred parameter/CONTIGUOUS condition fails. No undefined member value is read.
C769_valid__initialization_extension.evidence_limit: GNU ICE in gfc_conv_structure is not a source defect. Flang admits it only in the recorded f2018 mode.

R743_invalid__initialization_missing_poi.source_judgment: Valid negative with conforming minimal control.
R743_invalid__initialization_missing_poi.premise: The arrow has no operand after a valid POINTER component declaration. Inserting NULL() supplies the exact R743/R806/C813 alternative.
R743_invalid__initialization_missing_poi.evidence_limit: Generic pointer-initialization or expected-end-of-statement recovery does not identify the required missing operand and is uncredited.

R744_invalid__initialization_arithmetic.source_judgment: Valid negative with conforming minimal control.
R744_invalid__initialization_arithmetic.premise: scalar+0 is not a designator. The unchanged scalar itself is a previously declared, saved, defined, scalar INTEGER TARGET; removing +0 meets R744 and C769/C770.
R744_invalid__initialization_arithmetic.evidence_limit: Generic declaration or statement-end recovery is not the specific non-designator cause.

R745_invalid__initialization_private_lis.source_judgment: Valid negative with conforming minimal control.
R745_invalid__initialization_private_lis.premise: This role requires bare PRIVATE, not PRIVATE :: value. The module/type/member order is otherwise valid, and deleting the list/separator repairs just that grammar.
R745_invalid__initialization_private_lis.evidence_limit: Unexpected attribute/component-definition recovery is not accepted as evidence of the actual prohibited named list.

S7_5_4_6_005_valid__initialization_exter.source_judgment: Conforming run effect; retain run phase.
S7_5_4_6_005_valid__initialization_exter.premise: A prior abstract INTEGER function calculation has one INTEGER INTENT(IN) dummy. PROCEDURE(calculation)::outside gives the external function an explicit interface before the procedure-pointer initializer; its later nonelemental external definition has the same result/dummy characteristics. POINTER,NOPASS and the initial-proc-target form are valid. The program safely checks association and outside(4)=7.
S7_5_4_6_005_valid__initialization_exter.evidence_limit: GNU's 'outside is not a function' and ensuing missing module are not an independently established source defect. Flang's actual successful run remains f2018 only.

Only ', private' changes to ', public'; the public ordinary type, same scalar INTEGER component and the complete client constructor remain fixed. C7107's required constructor accessibility report therefore supplies a finite counterfactual connection to this explicit-access facet.
